name: Sweet Sleep Surrogate Syrup
summary: An Autochthonian alchemical formula unique to this book: a cloyingly sweet syrup distilled from molds and fungi that lets a 30-second nap grant all the benefits of a full night's sleep, widely stockpiled by cities to squeeze extra shifts out of Populat laborers.
description: A single dose grants all the benefits of a full night's rest - including feeling well-rested and a Conviction roll to regain Willpower - in a 30-second nap. It has no effect on Essence recovery, and a worker using it still needs one full night of true sleep every (Stamina x 2) nights or begins suffering sleep-deprivation penalties.
requirementsText: Alchemy ••; Intelligence + Occult roll (difficulty 3); Minimum Backing ••.
compatibility: Any character with the Alchemy formula and appropriate Backing; in practice used mainly on mortal Populat laborers.

name: Friction Banishing Preparation
summary: A mineral-oil-derived Autochthonian alchemical formula that perfectly eliminates friction between two surfaces, prized industrially for silencing grinding machinery but equally usable as an improvised hazard that turns a patch of floor into a nearly unwalkable slick.
description: A single vial coats a 10-by-10-foot patch of floor. The treated patch requires a successful Perception + Alertness roll (difficulty 1) to spot. Standing still on it requires a difficulty 4 Dexterity + Athletics roll; walking across it, or moving or standing up without something to hold onto, is difficulty 6. It can be neutralized with a simple Alchemy •/Backing • counter-agent, or left to degrade in open air after about a week.
requirementsText: Alchemy •••; Intelligence + Occult roll (difficulty 4); Minimum Backing •••.
compatibility: Any character with the Alchemy formula and appropriate Backing; also used industrially to ease machinery.

name: The Maker's Inertial Bile
summary: The most tightly restricted Autochthonian alchemical formula in the book: an acrid pale-gray fluid harvested from wild machine spirits that instantly halts and exorcises any spirit or animating force from a machine, automaton, or gremlin on contact - a substance the Tripartite polices as a serious crime for ordinary citizens to possess.
description: A single phial, shattered against any device, instantaneously stops a machine or automaton and exorcises any spirit or animating force from it - including gremlins, zombies, golems, corpses possessed by nemissaries, and automata summoned via protocols or spells (e.g. bone lions, bronze snakes). Important Tripartite officials keep a phial or two on hand for deactivating runaway factory machinery or exorcising marauding gremlins, but mere possession of the fluid by a member of the Populat is a crime worthy of severe downward mobility or, more probably, exile.
requirementsText: Alchemy •••••; Intelligence + Occult roll (difficulty 8); Minimum Backing •••••.
compatibility: Any character with the Alchemy formula and appropriate Backing; effectively restricted to senior Tripartite officials in practice.
